$comment: Everything about a server's portal membership that is NOT the owning repo's decision: default_disabled, on_behalf and updated_prompts, first copied from the live portal (live-snapshot-2026-09-25.json in the #1370 proposal). All six members are vendored; updated_tools appears only on a server with vendored: false, the escape hatch for an owning repo whose file fails the shape rules (api used it until mctlhq/mctl-api#396 gave every entry a reason). default_disabled here is the portal's allowlist switch for this server-to-portal mapping (Cloudflare docs, MCP portals, 'Use an allowlist pattern'): false means a synced tool or prompt with no updated_tools/updated_prompts entry is exposed; true means only entries with enabled: true are exposed and every other tool AND prompt is hidden, so with true a prompt must be listed in updated_prompts to stay visible. It agrees in meaning with, but is a different key from, the vendored files' own default_disabled: true (the owning repo's "an unlisted tool is disabled"). mcp-portal.tf reads the portal one from this file only.
